rule: Two deliveries for the same provider subscription (e.g. created + checkout completed) leave exactly one subscription row
invariant: SELECT count(*) <= 1 FROM subscription WHERE provider_subscription_id='sub_1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO subscription(id,provider_subscription_id,status) VALUES ('r1','sub_1','active') ON CONFLICT (provider_subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status
INSERT INTO subscription(id,provider_subscription_id,status) VALUES ('r2','sub_1','active') ON CONFLICT (provider_subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status
